post.summary: Retry or recover a failed public-application notification
post.description: Requires HOMEPAGE_VIEW (filter) and HOMEPAGE_EDIT. FAILED rows with providerMessageId are recovered to SENT without a second NHN send. FAILED rows without providerMessageId return to PENDING for the worker. SENT, PENDING, and RETRYING rows are not retryable.

get.description: Returns enabled textbooks whose business field is enabled and whose name is not blank. fieldCode, targetId, sort, page, and size apply together before the page window. totalCount and totalPages are the filtered totals, not the current page length. page is 0-based (default 0). size defaults to 20, Platform uses 10, and size must be 1..100. A page at or past totalPages returns empty items with the same totalCount and totalPages. sort defaults to LATEST (createdAt DESC, id DESC). sort=NAME orders textbookName ASC with PostgreSQL collation ko-KR-x-icu, then id ASC. Any other sort value is 400 BAD_REQUEST. fieldCode must be CAREER_EMPLOYMENT, ECONOMICS_FINANCE, ENTREPRENEURSHIP, or DIGITAL_LITERACY. Any other code is 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

parameters.name: fieldCode
parameters.description: Business field code. Omit or blank for every enabled field. CAREER_EMPLOYMENT, ECONOMICS_FINANCE, ENTREPRENEURSHIP, DIGITAL_LITERACY. Any other code is 400.

parameters.name: targetId
parameters.description: Education target id. Omit to ignore target.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: LATEST (default): createdAt DESC, id DESC. NAME: textbookName ASC (ko-KR-x-icu), id ASC. Any other value is 400.

schema.description: Public textbook list sort. Omit or use LATEST for createdAt DESC, id DESC. NAME orders textbookName ASC with PostgreSQL collation ko-KR-x-icu, then id ASC.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 0-based page index. Default 0.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Page size. Default 20. Minimum 1, maximum 100. Platform list uses 10.

get.description: Always stored original PII (not masked). HOMEPAGE_VIEW is enough; HOMEPAGE_PII_VIEW is not required. Every 200 writes homepage_admin_audit_log (PII_READ / TALENT_APPLICATION) and homepage_privacy_access_log. List GET stays masked. revealPii is a deprecated no-op.

parameters.name: revealPii
parameters.description: Deprecated no-op. Omitted, false, and true all return original PII and write a privacy/audit log.

get.description: Always stored original PII (not masked). HOMEPAGE_VIEW is enough; HOMEPAGE_PII_VIEW is not required. Every 200 writes homepage_admin_audit_log (PII_READ / CORPORATE_CONSULTATION) and homepage_privacy_access_log. List GET stays masked (maskedContactPhone). revealPii is a deprecated no-op.

parameters.name: revealPii
parameters.description: Deprecated no-op. Omitted, false, and true all return original PII and write a privacy/audit log.

get.summary: List recent public-application notification outbox rows
get.description: Requires HOMEPAGE_VIEW. Recipient emails are never included. SENT means the NHN provider returned a messageId, not mailbox delivery.

get.summary: List homepage-admin system inbox rows for the current MASTER administrator
get.description: Requires HOMEPAGE_VIEW plus CMS MASTER role. Returns only the caller's rows. This is in-app inbox state, not EMAIL/ALIMTALK outbox SENT/HELD/FAILED. Closing a UI panel must not call this read API.

get.summary: Count unread homepage-admin system inbox rows
get.description: Requires HOMEPAGE_VIEW plus CMS MASTER role. Counts only the caller's unread rows.
Validates a JWT issued by the JA CMS backend and returns the current homepage-authorized administrator profile.
phone and email are always PrivacyMaskingSupport-masked. Original contact PII is only on GET /{id}?revealPii=true.

revealPii=false (default) masks phone, email, addressRoad, and addressDetail with the same PrivacyMaskingSupport rules as the list. Name uses maskName. Education, career, and attachments stay omitted until revealed. revealPii=true returns originals only with HOMEPAGE_PII_VIEW and writes an audit/privacy log; otherwise 403.

parameters.name: revealPii
parameters.description: false (default): masked PII. true: original PII requires HOMEPAGE_PII_VIEW; otherwise 403.

phone.description: Stored phone (original). Empty is null, never "".

email.description: Stored email (original). Empty is null, never "".

ConsultationDetailResponse.description: Admin detail is always stored original PII. Empty strings are null. List stays masked. Not the careers talent-application revealPii contract.

contactPhone.description: Stored contact phone (original). Empty is null, never "".

consultationContent.description: Stored consultation body (original). Empty is null, never "".

name.description: Applicant name. revealPii=false uses PrivacyMaskingSupport.maskName (same as list and sponsorship talent). Original name only when revealPii=true.

email.description: revealPii=false: PrivacyMaskingSupport.maskEmail (same as list). revealPii=true: original. Empty is null, never "".

addressRoad.description: revealPii=false: PrivacyMaskingSupport.maskAddress. revealPii=true: original. Empty is null, never "".

addressDetail.description: revealPii=false: PrivacyMaskingSupport.maskAddress. revealPii=true: original. Empty is null, never "".

educationLevel.description: revealPii=false: omitted (null). revealPii=true: stored enum. careerType stays on the masked detail; this field does not until revealed.

schoolName.description: revealPii=false: omitted. revealPii=true: stored school name.

major.description: revealPii=false: omitted. revealPii=true: stored major. Empty is null, never "".

educationInfo.description: revealPii=false: omitted. revealPii=true: stored education body. Empty is null, never "".

careerInfo.description: revealPii=false: omitted. revealPii=true: stored career body. Empty is null, never "".

attachmentOriginalName.description: revealPii=false: omitted. revealPii=true: first attachment original name.

attachments.description: revealPii=false: empty array. revealPii=true: stored attachments in display order.
